chapter: Los Angeles, Central Avenue and the Apex
title: Father's rise in Los Angeles; family band; brother's birth
summary: How a newcomer gets known by sideman work; Royal began professionally in the family band with uncle, father and mother; brother Ernie born June 1921.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your father just get established upon arrival? with all these wealthy people immediately? (Inaudible) Did he get introduced? I mean, he came into town -- he hadn't worked Los Angeles before, had he?

Well, when you come into places like that, well, then you work sometimes with other people as side men and their orchestras and then you get seen and respected and people start liking. So they start calling you. He worked in in that manner by respect and --
So, well, he wasn't here very long before he was --
And so when you started to play professionally, it was with the band --
I started with the family band, yeah.
He came out with your father, right?
That's right. Everybody came together. Father, uncle and mother and I was born down the line on the way.
And so it was after you got here that your brother was born.
Yes, my brother was born here in -- December 2nd, 1921.
No, I'm -- June the 2nd is my brother's birthday. June the 2nd, 1921. Yeah.
